# Due dates for lodging and paying your BAS
Print or Download

## Lodgment due dates
### Quarterly reporting
| Quarter | Due date |
|-|-|
| 1. July, August and September | 28 October |
| 2. October, November and December | 28 February |

Due date for each quarter

However, a later lodgment and payment due date **does not apply for quarter 2** because the due date already includes a one-month extension.

### Annual reporting
The due date to lodge and pay your annual GST return is 31 October.

If you're [not required to lodge a tax return then](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/preparing-lodging-and-paying/reports-and-returns/due-dates-for-lodging-and-paying), the due date is 28 February following the annual tax period.

# BAS Due Dates 2026-2027: Key Deadlines Every Australian Business Should Know
## Blog Summary / Key Takeaways
Quarterly BAS deadlines for 2026–27 are 28 October 2026, 28 February 2027, 28 April 2027, and 28 July 2027, with applicable next-business-day adjustments.

Quarterly BAS for July–September 2026 is due 28 October 2026, or 25 November 2026 via an eligible registered agent. The December quarter is due 28 February 2027, or Monday 1 March 2027 because 28 February falls on a Sunday, with no standard agent extension.

## **When Is the Next BAS Due?**
The next standard quarterly BAS deadline is **28 October 2026** for the July–September 2026 quarter.

## ****BAS Due Dates for 2026–27****
### **Quarterly BAS Due Dates 2026–27**
The second quarterly BAS is different from the other quarters because it covers October–December and has a standard due date of 28 February.

## **Final Takeaway**
The first quarterly BAS deadline for the **2026–27 financial year is 28 October 2026**, covering July–September 2026. Other standard quarterly dates are 28 February 2027 (1 March 2027 because 28 February 2027 is a Sunday), 28 April 2027 and 28 July 2027.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**
### **2. When is BAS due in 2026–27?**
Quarterly BAS is generally due on 28 October 2026, 28 February 2027 (1 March 2027 because 28 February 2027 is a Sunday), 28 April 2027 and 28 July 2027.

### **3. When is the next BAS due?**
The next standard quarterly BAS due date is **28 October 2026** for the July–September 2026 quarter.

### **8. Is there an extension for the December quarter BAS?**
The December quarter has a specific due date of **28 February** and should not be treated as having the same standard agent extension as the other quarterly BAS periods.

web.description:
# Quarterly BAS Due Dates – Important Lodgement Deadlines to Know
## Quarterly BAS Due Dates: Key Lodgement Deadlines
### Standard Quarterly BAS Deadlines
- **Q2 (October–December):** Due 28 February (extended due to holidays)

These deadlines apply if you **lodge the BAS yourself** (for example, through the ATO Business Portal or myGov). The ATO confirms that quarterly BAS deadlines fall on the 28th of the month following each quarter’s end (ATO, 2025).

### Agent and Online Lodgement Extensions
Quarter 2 (the Dec quarter) already has a built-in extra month (due 28 Feb), so no further extension applies for that period.
